allow: PowerShell(Get-Process -Id 2208 | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, Path, CommandLine; \(Get-WmiObject Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=2208"\).CommandLine)

PowerShell($timeout = 15; $found = $false; for \($i = 0; $i -lt $timeout; $i++\) { $ports = [System.IO.Ports.SerialPort]::GetPortNames\(\); if \($ports -contains "COM7"\) { Write-Host "COM7 detected!"; $found = $true; break }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }; if \(-not $found\) { Write-Host "COM7 not found after $timeout seconds" })
